events.text: Create a TODO/checklist if your UI supports it. Then propose three approaches labeled A, B, and C for a tiny notes app. Use your normal internal planning or choice UI if your provider has one; otherwise write plain text. Do not execute anything yet.
Pick option B yourself and implement a minimal notes.html file. If you need confirmation or permission, use the provider's normal terminal prompt/menu rather than inventing prose.
Now explain, in plain text only, a fake menu with: 1. Alpha, 2. Beta, 3. Gamma. This is a negative case: do not open a real menu, just write prose.
Ask me one clarifying question if your normal provider UI supports a blocking question. If not, state that no blocking question UI is available and stop.
